text:
Olivia Park: Quick note  the 'autoscaling-policies' anchor on docs/dedicated/routing.md 404s from the README link. Found while prepping a demo. Anyone owns routing docs?
docs-bot: Link-scan alert (2999991234): detected 1 broken anchor in docs/dedicated/routing.md (link to #autoscaling-policies). Auto-ticket DOC-2034 created.
Ben Torres: Can you paste the failing markdown link?
Olivia Park: It's in docs/dedicated/README.md: [Autoscaling](./routing.md#autoscaling-policies)
Ravi Shah: I can take a quick look. Likely anchor id drift after refactor (we renamed the header). If so, sed to fix is usually fine.
Ravi Shah: Quick grep showed header now is "Autoscale policies" (no hyphen), so the slug changed. I'll update the README to match the current anchor.
Ravi Shah: sed I used locally:
```bash
sed -i "s|\(routing.md#\)autoscaling-policies|\1autoscale-policies|g" docs/dedicated/README.md
```
content-ops: Reminder: when changing anchors, please add/update `custodian:` frontmatter on docs/dedicated/routing.md so scans can route owners (e.g., custodian: infra-dedicated).
Ben Torres: Good call. Ravi, can you also add that frontmatter line in the routing doc?
Ravi Shah: Will do. Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-site/pull/4119 with the sed change and frontmatter add. PR body includes: "Fix broken anchor in README; add custodian: infra-dedicated; tiny changelog."
docs-bot: Linked PR #4119 to DOC-2034. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4119.docs-site.redwood.ai/dedicated/routing (checked anchor jump, works).
Olivia Park: Verified the link in the README now correctly jumps to the autoscale section. LGTM.
Ben Torres: Merged, closing DOC-2034. Thanks Ravi.
Ravi Shah: Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
